results.title: .ask
results.overview: Chris Vander Kaay, a YouTuber in his mid-40s, takes a mysterious life coach's advice to be brutally honest with his audience. His channel and life improve, but unforeseen darker consequences soon begin to unfold.

results.title: Latency
results.overview: When professional gamer Hana, who suffers from acute agoraphobia, receives new equipment that enhances her game, she begins to wonder if it is reading her mind – or controlling it.

results.title: The Polar Bear Prince
results.original_title: Kvitebjørn – Østenfor sol og vestenfor måne
results.overview: An adventurous girl, Liv, lives with her beloved grandfather in a small village nestled among majestic mountains and forests. One day she encounters a polar bear, who turns out to be a prince enchanted into animal form. To break the spell, they will have to face an evil witch.

results.title: Mission Improbable
results.overview: Limerick Youth Theatre presents "Mission Improbale" a short film spoof of the "Mission Impossible" trailers made as part of the Creative Show 2024.

results.title: Hanói!
results.overview: Siset, a young boy with a dark past seeks redemption in rural Catalonia in 1952, through a confession to Father Barroso. In this encounter, hidden secrets and deep desires are confronted, all while fervently exploring morality and repressed lust in post-war misery.

results.title: Edentity Crisis
results.overview: When middle-aged Ed buys a fake ID to join a senior citizen bowling league, he quickly finds himself immersed in a world of crime.

results.title: Looky-Loo
results.overview: An aspiring filmmaker’s voyeurism spirals into murder as he obsesses over a woman named Courtney, casting her as the star of his twisted film.

results.title: Sketty
results.overview: While running late to class, a student stumbles into someone who will scar him for all time

results.title: A Fragile Flower
results.overview: Thach Thao is a beautiful girl with an angelic beautiful voice, and the first time she sang on stage at Itango Club, Thao immediately caught the eye of a music producer named Son. Then, she was invited to cooperate in filming a music video called "A Fragile Flower". After the music video was released, Thach Thao became a renowned singer. She is beautiful, talented, so many men love her. Then, which man will Thao's heart belong to? And what is the dangerous disease that she encountered?

results.title: Wigglers
results.overview: A quirky cokehead who sells furbies online snorts a bad batch cursed by an amateur Wiccan.

results.title: Final Heat
results.overview: The married owners of a struggling functional fitness gym have the perfect plan to raise money: they’ll bring in the best athletes to compete in The Games to win the huge cash prize. They record everything documentary-style for the athletes to confess their secrets. As the team trains, egos clash, tempers flare, and a figure from the past threatens to destroy the team, the gym, and their lives.

results.title: Seeing Read
results.overview: Zoey is plunged into stress when she texts Miles, the guy she likes, to ask him out on a date, and is left “on read”.

results.title: Grown
results.overview: With their mother missing for three days, it is Emmanuel’s job to pick up his little brother Alex after school. One evening, as they make their way back home, Alex’s reluctance to listen to his older sets their night on a course that alters their lives forever.

results.title: Molecular Delusions
results.overview: For one night, Kika collects audio recordings of orgasms. The acoustic phenomena generated by this hypnotic trance reveal the form that had remained hidden in the shadows.

results.title: Kasalo
results.overview: Two strangers meet through a ride-sharing app and find themselves sharing more than what's expected. Both having problems with their respective marital lives, they find comfort in each other's company.

results.title: Eyecatcher
results.overview: In the heart of Koreatown, Los Angeles, a young woman must protect her ailing father from a sinister entity.

results.title: The Day Everything Changed
results.overview: Mario, used to be a man who had planned a happy future with his wife; until one night, a robbery ends up taking her life. From that moment on, his only objective is now to avenge on those who took away his happiness.
